tasks.title: Fix login bug
Sign-in is broken for some users
tasks.body: Several users report they can't log in — the sign-in request fails and they never reach the app. Track down and fix the login bug so affected accounts can authenticate again.

tasks.title: Dark mode
Add a dark appearance option
tasks.body: Give users a way to switch the interface to a dark color scheme from settings, and remember their preference between visits.

tasks.title: CSV export
Let users export their tasks to a spreadsheet
tasks.body: Add a button that downloads every task in the workspace as a CSV file that opens cleanly in a spreadsheet application.

tasks.title: Add 2FA
Support two-factor authentication at sign-in
tasks.body: Let users enable a second verification step with an authenticator app when logging in, for extra account security.

tasks.title: Search is slow
Improve the speed of task search
tasks.body: Searching across tasks currently takes several seconds. Profile the query path and speed it up so results come back quickly.

tasks.title: Profile pictures
Allow uploading a profile photo
tasks.body: Users should be able to upload an avatar image that shows on their profile and next to their messages.

tasks.title: Members are locked out at the sign-in screen
tasks.body: People cannot get past the sign-in screen to reach their account.

tasks.title: Repair the broken credential check blocking access
tasks.body: The verification step rejects valid users, so nobody can enter the product.

tasks.title: The application quits immediately on launch
tasks.body: It shuts down the moment it opens, before anything is shown.

tasks.title: Resolve the fatal error during boot
tasks.body: A hard failure while starting up stops the program from ever running.

tasks.title: The dashboard takes forever to appear
tasks.body: Opening the main view is painfully slow for everyone.

tasks.title: Reduce home page load latency
tasks.body: Speed up how quickly the landing screen becomes usable after navigation.

tasks.title: Let people take back a message they already sent
tasks.body: Give users a way to retract a chat message after it has gone out.

tasks.title: Add recall for outgoing conversations
tasks.body: Support unsending a note once it has left the composer.

tasks.title: Tell me when a document I follow changes
tasks.body: Alert people after edits happen to a file they care about.

tasks.title: Push updates on modifications to tracked files
tasks.body: Send a heads-up whenever a watched piece of content is revised.

tasks.title: Show the product in the user's own language
tasks.body: Adapt the interface wording to each person's locale.

tasks.title: Add translation support across the app
tasks.body: Let the software render its text in multiple languages.
